title: Qwen3 Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要核查前沿推理模型训练数据披露、Long-CoT、RL verifier 与可复现性缺口的读者
one_line: Qwen3 partially discloses 36T pretraining, long-CoT filtering, 3,995 GRPO query-verifier pairs, fusion SFT, and distillation while withholding underlying data and verifier/audit details.
Qwen3 技术报告部分披露了 36T 预训练、Long-CoT 过滤、3,995 个 GRPO query-verifier pairs、融合 SFT 与蒸馏，但未公开底层数据、verifier 细节或审计日志。
why: It exposes useful pipeline interfaces and explicit unknowns without making thinking-budget or scaling claims a reproducible recipe.
inclusion_reason: High-impact frontier report with partial 36T, long-CoT, 3,995-pair RL, fusion-SFT, and distillation disclosure.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports often describe post-training outcomes while leaving the provenance, construction, and auditability of the data objects incomplete. For reasoning models, readers need to separate a stated stage or aggregate count from a reusable recipe: source data, retained and rejected examples, verifier behavior, reward calibration, and contamination controls can remain undisclosed.

Qwen3 is useful for this disclosure question because its report names several pre-training and post-training interfaces but does not release the associated training corpora or complete audit artifacts. This Card records the disclosed boundary and the remaining unknowns rather than treating the report's model results or thinking-budget interface as evidence of a reproducible pipeline.

前沿模型报告往往说明后训练结果，却未完整交代数据对象的来源、构造过程和可审计性。对于推理模型，读者需要把已说明的训练阶段或汇总数量，与可复用配方区分开来：源数据、保留与拒绝样本、verifier 行为、奖励校准以及污染控制都可能未被披露。

Qwen3 对这一披露问题具有参考价值，因为其报告点明了若干预训练和后训练接口，却没有公开相应训练语料或完整审计工件。本 Card 记录已披露的边界与仍然未知的内容，而不把模型结果或 thinking-budget 接口当作可复现流水线的证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report presents Qwen3 as a dense and MoE model family and discloses a stage-level training narrative. It reports approximately 36T pre-training tokens across 119 languages and dialects, a long-CoT cold start, a reasoning-RL stage using 3,995 query-verifier pairs and GRPO, thinking/non-thinking fusion through continual SFT, and logits-based strong-to-weak distillation for smaller models.

The relevant data and feedback objects are only partially exposed. The report identifies verified reference answers or code tests for cold-start problems, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct query filtering, QwQ-32B candidate-response generation, and rejection-sampled thinking data. It does not provide the underlying records, source manifests, complete verifier or reward definition, or retention and error audits.

该报告将 Qwen3 描述为包含 dense 与 MoE 模型的系列，并披露了阶段级训练叙事：约 36T 个预训练 tokens、覆盖 119 种语言和方言；Long-CoT cold start；使用 3,995 个 query-verifier pairs 和 GRPO 的推理 RL；通过 continual SFT 融合 thinking/non-thinking 模式；以及面向小模型的基于 logits 的强到弱蒸馏。

其中的数据与反馈对象仅被部分公开。报告指出 cold-start 问题具有已验证的参考答案或代码测试，使用 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 过滤查询、QwQ-32B 生成候选响应，并以 rejection sampling 生成 thinking 数据。但它未提供底层记录、来源清单、完整 verifier 或奖励定义，以及保留率和错误审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
For pre-training, the report states that the approximately 36T-token mixture covers code, STEM, reasoning, books, multilingual text, and synthetic content. It describes extracting text from PDF-like documents with Qwen2.5-VL and refining it with Qwen2.5, plus synthesizing textbooks, question-answering, instructions, and code snippets with Qwen2.5-family models. It reports three pre-training stages, but not raw sources, mixture weights, source licenses, or manifests.

For long-CoT cold start, problems cover mathematics, code, logical reasoning, and general STEM and are paired with verified reference answers or code-based tests. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct removes hard-to-verify or easy-without-CoT queries and labels domains. QwQ-32B generates candidate responses; when it repeatedly fails, human annotators assess accuracy. Response filtering excludes incorrect answers, substantial repetition, unsupported guesswork, thinking-summary inconsistencies, inappropriate language or style changes, and suspected similarity to potential validation items. Exact prompts, thresholds, sample counts, and yields are undisclosed.

For reasoning RL, the report says 3,995 query-verifier pairs satisfy separation from cold start, learnability, difficulty, and sub-domain coverage criteria, and that GRPO updates the model. It describes large batches, many rollouts per query, and off-policy training without values. The report then performs continual SFT for thinking/non-thinking fusion: thinking data is rejection-sampled from Stage-1 queries with the Stage-2 model, and non-thinking data is curated across several task types with automatically generated quality checklists. A later general-RL stage and logits-based strong-to-weak distillation are named at high level; their detailed data and optimization configuration are unknown.

对于预训练，报告称约 36T-token 的混合数据覆盖代码、STEM、推理、书籍、多语言文本和合成内容；使用 Qwen2.5-VL 从类 PDF 文档抽取文本，再由 Qwen2.5 精炼；并用 Qwen2.5 系列模型合成教材、问答、指令和代码片段。报告给出了三阶段预训练，但未公开原始来源、混合权重、来源许可或清单。

对于 Long-CoT cold start，问题覆盖数学、代码、逻辑推理和通用 STEM，并配有已验证的参考答案或基于代码的测试。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 去除难以验证或无需 CoT 即可解决的查询，并标注领域。QwQ-32B 生成候选响应；当其重复失败时，人工标注者评估准确性。响应过滤会排除错误答案、大量重复、缺乏依据的猜测、thinking-summary 不一致、不恰当的语言或风格变化，以及疑似与潜在验证集相似的内容。精确 prompts、阈值、样本量和保留率均未披露。

对于推理 RL，报告称 3,995 个 query-verifier pairs 满足与 cold start 分离、可学习性、难度和子领域覆盖等标准，并使用 GRPO 更新模型。它说明了大 batch、每查询较多 rollouts 和 off-policy 训练，但没有给出数值。随后报告通过 continual SFT 融合 thinking/non-thinking：thinking 数据由 Stage-2 模型在 Stage-1 查询上以 rejection sampling 生成，non-thinking 数据则覆盖多类任务并通过自动生成的质量 checklist 进行整理。后续 general-RL 阶段和基于 logits 的强到弱蒸馏仅在高层级被提及，其数据和优化配置未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official technical report explicitly supports the following disclosure facts: approximately 36T pre-training tokens over 119 languages and dialects; OCR/refinement and Qwen-family synthetic-content steps; long-CoT cold-start filtering; 3,995 reasoning-RL query-verifier pairs trained with GRPO; and rejection-sampled thinking data plus curated non-thinking data for fusion SFT. It also states that model weights are publicly accessible under Apache-2.0, and official Qwen code, project, and model-release pages are available.

These are report disclosures, not independently reproduced training-data results. The report provides benchmark evaluations and describes thinking-budget control, but neither establishes source-data provenance, verifier validity, reward calibration, contamination resistance, or data-pipeline reproducibility. The official release endpoints expose model and usage artifacts, not the reported training corpora or a complete construction audit.

官方技术报告明确支持以下披露事实：约 36T 个预训练 tokens、覆盖 119 种语言和方言；OCR/精炼和 Qwen 系列合成内容步骤；Long-CoT cold-start 过滤；使用 GRPO 训练的 3,995 个推理 RL query-verifier pairs；以及用于融合 SFT 的 rejection-sampled thinking 数据和整理后的 non-thinking 数据。报告还称模型权重以 Apache-2.0 公开可得，并存在官方 Qwen 代码、项目和模型发布页面。

这些内容是报告披露，而非被独立复现的训练数据结果。报告给出了 benchmark 评估并描述 thinking-budget 控制，但两者都不能证明源数据来源、verifier 有效性、奖励校准、抗污染性或数据流水线可复现性。官方发布端点公开的是模型和使用工件，而不是所述训练语料或完整构造审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The report is not a standalone dataset release. Its value for this atlas is that it exposes multiple interfaces of a frontier reasoning pipeline in one primary source: aggregate pre-training composition, a cold-start answer/test contract, model-assisted filtering and generation, a stated 3,995-pair RL interface, fusion-SFT construction, and a distillation path.

Its contribution to a disclosure ledger is therefore comparative rather than a claim of full reproducibility. The useful novelty is the coexistence of concrete stage-level facts with explicit missing evidence: no released data records, complete verifier specification, rejected-output log, source-license account, or complete contamination audit.

该报告不是独立的数据集发布。它对本图谱的价值在于：在同一一手来源中公开了前沿推理流水线的多个接口，包括汇总级预训练组成、cold-start 的答案/测试约定、模型辅助的过滤与生成、明确说明的 3,995-pair RL 接口、融合 SFT 构造和蒸馏路径。

因此，它对披露台账的贡献是可比较性，而不是完全可复现性的主张。其有用的新意在于具体的阶段级事实与明确缺失的证据并存：没有公开数据记录、完整 verifier 规范、拒绝输出日志、来源许可说明或完整污染审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The underlying pre-training, cold-start, SFT, RL, query-verifier, and rejected-output datasets are not released. Raw source names, mixture weights, per-stage sample counts, prompts, decoding settings, filtering thresholds, retention yields, exact teacher-to-student mapping, and optimizer configuration remain incomplete or unknown.

The verifier and reward contract cannot be independently audited: the report identifies reference answers/code tests and query-verifier pairs, but does not disclose the complete verifier implementation, reward formula, calibration, or false-accept and false-reject measurements. It mentions a validation query set and filters suspected validation-item similarity, but does not publish split membership, a full contamination protocol, or measured leakage results. Human assessment is mentioned only for a repeated QwQ-32B failure condition; rater guidance, volume, agreement, and adjudication are undisclosed.

Apache-2.0 model availability and official code/model pages do not establish rights to, or reproducibility of, mixed and synthetic training data. These gaps limit this Card to a partial, report-level disclosure record.

底层预训练、cold-start、SFT、RL、query-verifier 和拒绝输出数据集均未发布。原始来源名称、混合权重、每阶段样本量、prompts、解码设置、过滤阈值、保留率、精确的教师到学生映射，以及优化器配置仍不完整或未知。

verifier 与奖励约定无法被独立审计：报告指出了参考答案/代码测试和 query-verifier pairs，但没有公开完整 verifier 实现、奖励公式、校准或 false-accept 与 false-reject 测量。它提到验证查询集并过滤疑似与验证项相似的内容，却未发布 split 成员、完整污染协议或测得的泄漏结果。人工评估仅在 QwQ-32B 重复失败这一条件下被提及；标注者指引、数量、一致性和仲裁过程均未披露。

Apache-2.0 模型可用性以及官方代码/模型页面并不证明混合与合成训练数据的权利或可复现性。这些缺口使本 Card 只能作为部分、报告级的数据披露记录。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, this report supports a structured comparison of what frontier releases disclose about data objects and feedback contracts. A curator can record the named stages, the 3,995-pair RL interface, answer/test checks, model roles, and stated filtering goals while preserving unreleased fields as unknown.

It is useful for audits of long-CoT, SFT, RLVR, and distillation claims because it prevents public weights and high-level training prose from being mistaken for a released data recipe. It should be read alongside reports that disclose different parts of the pipeline, using shared questions about sources, filters, verifier/reward design, splits, contamination, licenses, and item-level lineage.

This Card deliberately does not classify Qwen3's thinking-budget behavior or reported performance as a Track 8 scaling contribution. Its scope is the report's data-disclosure boundary and audit risk.

对于 Track 12，该报告可用于结构化比较前沿发布对数据对象和反馈约定披露了什么。策展者可以记录其命名的阶段、3,995-pair RL 接口、答案/测试检查、模型角色和已说明的过滤目标，同时将未发布字段保留为 unknown。

它对 Long-CoT、SFT、RLVR 和蒸馏主张的审计很有用，因为它能防止公开权重和高层训练描述被误认为已发布的数据配方。应将其与披露流水线其他部分的报告一并阅读，并围绕来源、过滤器、verifier/奖励设计、split、污染、许可和项目级 lineage 使用一致的问题进行比较。

本 Card 特意不将 Qwen3 的 thinking-budget 行为或报告性能归为 Track 8 的缩放贡献；其范围是该报告的数据披露边界与审计风险。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the 36T-token statement as an aggregate disclosure, not a source manifest or a licensed dataset release.
  • Separate the 3,995 query-verifier pairs and GRPO claim from any unreported verifier implementation, reward formula, rollout count, or calibration audit.
  • Record Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, QwQ-32B, and human assessment only in the specific roles disclosed for cold start.
  • Check that rejection-sampled thinking data and curated non-thinking SFT data have no released examples, counts, prompts, or retention yields.
  • Keep thinking-budget behavior and benchmark results outside this Track 12 disclosure assessment.

• 将 36T-token 表述视为汇总级披露，而不是来源清单或具有明确许可的数据集发布。
  • 将 3,995 个 query-verifier pairs 与 GRPO 的主张，同未公开的 verifier 实现、奖励公式、rollout 数和校准审计区分开来。
  • 对 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct、QwQ-32B 和人工评估，只记录其在 cold start 中被明确披露的角色。
  • 核查 rejection-sampled thinking 数据和整理后的 non-thinking SFT 数据没有公开示例、数量、prompts 或保留率。
  • 将 thinking-budget 行为和 benchmark 结果排除在此 Track 12 披露评估之外。
